reason_for_skipping_inference: RTX 2060 6 GB insufficient for SD1.5 + ControlNet simultaneously; model download network stall. Hardware constraint. Inference test skipped per project decision.

exr_stats.verdict: CLEAN — full-precision metric depth, no masking needed

D1_depth_data_is_geometry_truth.statement: Blender/SketchUp EXR metric depth IS geometry truth. The prior 8-bit depth_condition.png failure was purely a conversion artefact (range 186-255 out of 256), not a data quality problem. The raw EXR is authoritative.
D1_depth_data_is_geometry_truth.implication: Do NOT replace Blender depth with MiDaS as canonical source. MiDaS is a compatibility experiment only (AI_ESTIMATED_DEPTH label stands).

D2_depth_conditioning_is_viable.statement: Depth conditioning is viable. All 4 deterministic mappings produce full-range, high-contrast depth images that carry the geometry signal ControlNet needs: sofa vs TV unit vs back wall vs doorway all clearly separated.
D2_depth_conditioning_is_viable.caveat: Empirical ControlNet geometry-drift improvement not tested. Proceeding on data quality evidence. Validate on first cloud run against geometry criteria.

D3_recommended_depth_mapping.rationale: Most robust to scene-to-scene variation. p5-p95 is the correct cross-view shared rule — avoids single outlier pixels dominating the scale. Used consistently across all 6 cubemap faces.
D3_recommended_depth_mapping.fallback: B_LINEAR_DEPTH (p0.5-p99.5) if E shows banding artefacts
D3_recommended_depth_mapping.convention: near=white(255), far=black(0) — matches MiDaS/ControlNet training convention

D4_canonical_architecture.midas_role: compatibility_experiment_only — label AI_ESTIMATED_DEPTH, never geometry truth
D4_canonical_architecture.next_model_test: Validate depth conditioning on higher-quality generation model (not SD1.5) — Cloudflare FLUX img2img or equivalent when ControlNet Depth endpoint available
